note: Each register's [[representation.parallel]] accepts the case-equivalent literals First and first of one 2020 edition (`case_aliases`: a plain parallel entry refuses two literals in one edition, and a co-delivered member has one code list for both columns). PERCOLUMN (per-column coding and metadata, fingerprints pinned by `source_codings`) keeps First's 01 and first's 02 on their own alias windows with their own books and conformance, and the backing state has neither a value set nor a book; the code-search index reaches both codes through the alias windows. First's list also has 09350 Okänt, certified by a `[[coding.sentinel]]` for codes-first on that column, so First's alias conformance is extended with one sentinel (the allowed twin of the slim alias-certificate tampering test). FACTS (per-column metadata, no lists) keeps each column's operational definition and attribution, and first's absent attribution stays absent. CONTESTED's first has two lists disagreeing on 02's label, so its coding is withheld: the per-column entry publishes neither column in 2020 rather than falling back to a shared domain, and only the 2021 First state outside the window remains. Expected values are the replaced tests' asserted members, books, facts and withheld windows.
fails_if: percolumn: `form_representations` (source_representations.py) keeps the shared state's value set or book for per-column coding, or gives an alias window its sibling's domain; the writer drops or misstates an alias window's conformance (First extended 2/1/1 with sentinel 09350, first conforming) or refuses every alias certificate; `code_variable_map` drops its alias-window union (income loses 01, 02 and 09350 from code_index); facts: per-column alias windows inherit the state's or a sibling's operational definition or attribution; contested: a per-column column without one complete domain falls back to shared coding, publishes the other column alone, or withholds the 2021 state outside the window
